title: List Item
summary: Declarative option descriptor owned by Dropdown, and a general list row: supporting line, interactive rows with roving focus, sf-sortable items and pinned rows.

kind.description: What the list item carries: plain text, an icon, a checkbox, an avatar or a colour.

type.description: Legacy name for kind, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

supporting.description: A second line under the title, one step of the size ladder smaller. Not used by a Dropdown option.

interactive.description: A row a person acts on: hover, focus and selection states, one Tab stop per list with arrow keys, Home and End, and sf-list-item-activate on click or Enter.

sortable-item.description: The row's item id in the surrounding sf-sortable list. The row carries data-sf-sortable-item and a drag handle; the list's keyboard reordering applies.

pinned.description: A row of an sf-sortable list that does not move: no handle, not an item of the list, its handle slot kept empty so the text columns line up.

item_contract.visible_label: text or the type-specific visible title

standalone.const: Non-interactive visual preview without a synthetic role or Tab stop, unless interactive or sortable-item makes it a list row.

owned_option.const: Dropdown owns listbox semantics, focus, selection, form state and events.

decorations.const: Icons, avatar images, color swatches and checkbox marks do not add focus targets.

list_row.const: An interactive or sortable row is one stop of its list (the nearest sf-sortable, listbox, list or [data-sf-list], else its parent): roving tabindex, ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End between rows; a keyboard reorder in progress keeps the arrows. One-line height is the control height of the size; two-line adds one line of the step below.

sf-list-item-activate.summary: An interactive row was clicked or took Enter (not a control inside it, and not Enter on a row of an sf-sortable list, where Enter picks the row up).

accessibility.role: option when rendered by Dropdown; none in standalone preview and list rows (the list owns the role; aria-current marks a selected row)
accessibility.focus: Owned by the parent Dropdown composite for options; a standalone preview is not focusable; an interactive or sortable row is a roving Tab stop of its list, with an inset focus ring.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-list-item as a direct child of sf-dropdown to declare an option, or as a list row: supporting for a second line, interactive for a row a person acts on, sortable-item inside sf-sortable, pinned for a row that stays in place.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not use a standalone sf-list-item without interactive as a button, link or independent checkbox
Do not place independently interactive controls inside a listbox option
Do not put data-sf-sortable-item on the sf-list-item host: it is boxless; use sortable-item
